misattribution.description: From Jan 2026 two SG-coded duplicate records (created by SG staff for regional billing) captured POs of a MY hospital and a VN hospital, so the raw SG series gains a level and the MY/VN series lose one.

examples.title: Two 'SG customers' are really a MY and a VN hospital

records.cardName: Benh vien Da khoa Song Sen

examples.rawStory: Raw: two new SG customers from Jan 2026 worth S$1.04M in the last 12 months.
examples.dedupStory: De-duplicated: they are Taman Seri Medical Centre (MY) and Song Sen General Hospital (VN). SG's 12M value falls by 5.7%.

examples.title: A top-3 account is shrinking, hidden behind a 'new' customer

records.cardName: Bukit Damai Specialist Hosp. Sdn Bhd

examples.rawStory: Raw: one customer lost (no POs after Mar 2026), one new customer (first PO Apr 2026), one flat.
examples.dedupStory: De-duplicated: one hospital, a top-3 MY account, down 35% year on year.

examples.title: The real cross-sell gap is consumables, not instruments
examples.rawStory: Raw: an 'A-only' SPD customer and a separate 'C-only' QTS customer, two false cross-sell gaps.
examples.dedupStory: De-duplicated: one hospital that buys reagents (A) and instruments (C) but no lab consumables (B).

examples.title: VN's growth is understated

records.cardName: Bệnh viện Đa khoa Sông Sen
Benh vien Da khoa Song Sen

examples.rawStory: Raw: Song Sen General Hospital appears under three spellings, one of them coded to SG.
examples.dedupStory: De-duplicated: S$348k of VN orders move back from SG (3.9% of VN's 12M value).

examples.title: A 'lost' customer that never left
examples.rawStory: Raw: Yangon Lakeside Hospital looks lost and 'Rangoon Lakeside Hosp' looks new.
examples.dedupStory: De-duplicated: the same hospital (Rangoon is the old romanisation of Yangon), ordering steadily.

note: Merging duplicate customers alone does not change country × product totals. Only misattribution (wrong country) and miscategorisation (wrong product) move value between cells, and those are the only changes the de-duplicated view shows.
